name: Button
summary: Primary action affordance. Renders a labeled, focusable, intent-bearing control. Five sizes × eight intents × three shapes. The single most important interaction component in Lumen. v0.12.2 dialed the primary-hover glow ladder down: rest unchanged at the brand-defining 0 0 16px lime-a25, hover trims to 0 0 20px lime-a28 plus quieter mid/outer halo layers (see ADR 0022).

intent.description: Role + chrome of the button. v0.9 expanded from 4 to 8 (added ghost, outline, danger-soft, ai, glass; tertiary kept as alias of ghost). One primary CTA per view; danger pairs with confirmation; ai is a tonal lime + sparkle for AI-driven primaries; glass is for floating overlays.

size.description: Height: xs 24 / sm 32 / md 40 (default) / lg 48 / xl 56 px. Mobile primary uses lg minimum to clear 44 px touch target. xs is desktop-density only (table-row inline, chip-close).

shape.description: v0.9 NEW. rect = radius.control.md (~6 px) operator default. pill = full radius for hero / AI / marketing CTAs. round = square dimensions + full radius (use IconButton instead for icon-only).

leadingIcon.description: 12 px on xs/sm, 14 px on md, 16 px on lg, 20 px on xl. Replaced by spinner during loading or checkmark during success.

trailingIcon.description: Use sparingly — primary CTAs should not bracket the label with two icons. ChevronDown for dropdown triggers, ArrowRight for advance flows.

fullWidth.description: w-full. Common in modal footers and mobile CTAs.

loading.description: Replaces leadingIcon with a spinner. Sets aria-busy=true. Suppresses click. Visually distinct from disabled (color preserved).

success.description: v0.9 NEW. Transient — when flipped to true, the button shows a checkmark + tonal-lime surface for 1.6 s, then auto-clears. Use after a successful async action (Saved, Booked, Quoted).

pressed.description: v0.9 NEW. aria-pressed=true. Renders the lime-tinted selected surface. For ToggleButton / Segmented option / split-button menu trigger.

disabled.description: Sets aria-disabled=true (not the disabled attribute) inside forms. Loading auto-disables.

pill.description: v0.4 LEGACY — alias of shape='pill'. Kept for backwards compat; new code uses shape.

glow.description: v0.4 LEGACY — layers .lumen-glow-cta on top of the standard primary glow ladder. Hero CTAs only (landing page primaries, AI primary).

onClick.description: Required unless disabled, loading, asChild, or as='a'.

keyboard: Tab - move focus to next control
Shift+Tab - move focus to previous control
rules: Visible focus ring required. Do NOT remove via outline:none.
Primary intent uses dual-ring focus (canvas-colored 2 px inner + lime 4 px outer) so the ring maintains 3:1 against the lime button surface (Atlassian 2024 fix; WCAG 2.4.13).
Disabled state must use aria-disabled, not the disabled attribute, when used inside a form (so the button stays in tab order).
Loading state must set aria-busy=true and suppress onClick.
Success state must announce via live region when used as confirmation feedback.
Pressed state (aria-pressed) is for toggle / segmented behavior — do NOT use it for momentary buttons.
Label must contain at least one visible character. Icon-only requires the IconButton component with a required aria-label.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: hover-color transitions, glow ladder pulses, and AI shimmer are dropped under reduce; the resting glow stays steady.

do: Use one primary intent per view. Multiple primaries = no primary.
Lead the label with a verb: 'Save changes', 'Get rates', 'Delete account'. Numerate when possible: 'Add 3 lanes' not 'Add lanes'.
Pair danger intent with a confirmation dialog OR a HoldToConfirm pattern (deferred to v0.9.x).
Pair loading with optimistic feedback elsewhere if the operation takes >2 s. Use a progress bar in the page if the action takes >5 s.
Use the success prop for short-lived confirmation feedback ('Saved', 'Sent', 'Quoted'). Pair with a live region announcement.
Use intent='ai' for AI-driven primary actions (Improve, Summarize, Suggest, Quote-with-AI). Pair with a sparkle leading icon.
Use shape='pill' for hero / marketing CTAs and the AI primary. Operator pages stay shape='rect' for density.
Use intent='danger-soft' for destructive actions in tight contexts (table-row delete, settings) where solid red over-emphasizes.
dont: Don't stack three primary buttons in a row.
Don't use Title Case. Use sentence case.
Don't disable a button without explaining why nearby.
Don't put icons on both sides of a short label. Pick one.
Don't use intent='primary' for a destructive action — that's intent='danger'.

Don't render white or near-white text on the Spring Green accent surface. The primary action surface is bound to color.action.primary.fg ({color.accent.fg} = #07120D, 14.7:1 AAA). White on spring green is ~1.4:1 — a WCAG AA fail. Lint rule lint-no-white-on-accent enforces this.

Don't use the shadcn token-bridge utilities (`bg-primary text-primary-foreground` etc.) in product code. They're unreliable in Tailwind v4 (ADR 0015). Use the .lumen-btn-* defensive classes or direct semantic refs.
Don't translate or scale the button on press. Press feedback is filter brightness(0.92) + glow ladder shrink. Decelerate, don't bounce.
Don't use intent='ai' for non-AI actions. The sparkle + tonal lime is reserved for AI affordances; over-using it dilutes the signal.
Don't apply intent='glass' to default primary actions — operator pages rarely have the canvas to make glass work.

changelog.note: Initial release. Four intents, three sizes, loading, full-width, leading/trailing icons.

Pill shape (via `pill` prop). Glow halo (`glow` prop) for hero CTAs. xl size (56 px hero). Accent.fg pinned to obsidian #0a0a0d for 12.6:1 AAA on lime. (v0.11 retunes accent.fg to #07120D for 14.7:1 AAA on spring green #00FA8A.)
Heights re-bound to `size.control.*` semantic tokens. Padding migrated from raw px to `space.inset.squish.*` semantic refs (Curtis 2016 / Atlassian compositional pattern).
Primary intent — pinned bg/fg to direct Lumen-token refs to bypass the shadcn bridge fragility in Tailwind v4. See ADR 0015.

Eight intents (added ghost, outline, danger-soft, ai, glass; tertiary kept as alias of ghost). Five sizes (added xs=24 for table inline). Three shapes (rect/pill/round). Three-state glow ladder for primary (rest 16/0.25 → hover 24/0.4 → active 8/0.2). Dual-ring focus indicator on lime accent surfaces (Atlassian 2024 fix; WCAG 2.4.13). New props: shape, success (transient checkmark+verb), pressed (aria-pressed). Press feedback dropped translate-y; replaced with filter brightness(0.92).
Danger bg deepened red.500 → red.600 (#c92626) to clear WCAG AA Normal. White on red.600 = 5.2:1.

Implementation moved from cva inline-Tailwind utilities to globals.css `.lumen-btn-*` defensive classes. The cva button now composes class names (not Tailwind arbitrary values), guaranteeing dev/prod parity in Tailwind v4. See ADR 0016.
`intent='tertiary'` is now an alias of `intent='ghost'`. Both work; ghost is the new canonical name. Tertiary will be removed in v1.0.

Recolored — primary surface re-anchored from Warp lime #4ade80 to Spring Green #00FA8A. Accent.fg retuned from #0a0a0d to #07120D for 14.7:1 AAA on the new hue. Glow ladder RGB shifted from (74,222,128) to (0,250,138). Danger bg refined: status.danger.500 #ef4444 → #E5484D and CTA bg.rest = status.danger.700 (#B71D2A) for AA Normal. No API surface change. See ADR 0018.

Canvas neutralized — the button surface tokens (action.primary.bg, action.primary.fg) are unchanged; the dark canvas behind primary buttons retunes from #171A18 (obsidian-mint) to #0D0D0D (neutral obsidian). Spring-green accent has the hue stage to itself (canvas no longer carries a faint green tilt). No API surface change. See ADR 0020.

Primary-button hover bloom dialed down at the token + layered-halo level. --shadow-button-glow-hover retuned 0 0 24px lime-a40 → 0 0 20px lime-a28 (cascades into base :hover and the first layer of the layered halo). Layered halo middle layer trimmed 0 0 24px lime-a20 → 0 0 20px lime-a14; wide outer layer (the user-reported 'bloom edge') trimmed 0 0 48px lime-a10 → 0 0 32px lime-a08. .lumen-glow-cta:hover (hero CTAs) trimmed in lockstep so standard-vs-hero hierarchy stays intact. Rest (16px lime-a25 — the brand voice per ADR 0018), active (8px lime-a20), focus, dual-ring, and every alpha primitive unchanged. User screenshot 2026-05-06 of /library LoginCard 'Send magic link' caught the bloom (~40 px past the button on every side). See ADR 0022. No API surface change.
